messages:
erin: Heads-up — planning the canary for model-serving v2.1 tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Need deploy owner, SRE smoke checks, and rollback readiness. Proposed ramp below. Please ack and flag any concerns.

sasha: I can own infra/SRE checks during the window. What time zone is 10:00? UTC works for infra.

erin: 10:00 UTC. Thanks @sasha. I'm the rollout owner for canary coordination and communications.

raj: I'll own telemetry/metrics (latency, errors, qps). I'll watch the dashboards and set short-term alerts.

danny: I'll watch model quality / regression signals (top-k diffs on the eval set + user-facing sample set).

oncall-sre: I'll be the on-call fallback. If anything spikes beyond thresholds, ping me and we'll trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job created: deploys/model-serving:v2.1 @ 1952416800 (10:00 UTC). CI artifacts: build-2026-03-20-8f4d.

erin: Ramp plan (proposed):
```
- 10:00 UTC: deploy -> 0.5% internal (dev + infra smoke) -- 10m
- 10:10 UTC: 1% public -- 20m
- 10:30 UTC: 5% public -- 30m
- 11:00 UTC: 20% public -- 60m
- 12:00 UTC: 100% if all green
```

erin: Smoke checklist (short):
- deploy job completes without pod restarts > 1 per replica
- p50 latency <= 150ms, p95 <= 350ms
- error rate (5m) < 0.5%
- no regressions in top-100 sample diffs reported by @danny
- logs show no OOM or repeated 5xx stack traces

sasha: Adding infra items: node CPU < 70% sustained, GPU mem pressure < 80%, no abnormal throttling. I'll run canary load script for the first 15m.

raj: Alert thresholds I'm going to wire:
- errors > 1% sustained for 5m -> pager to oncall-sre
- p95 latency > 500ms for 10m -> page to oncall-sre + slack #eng-sre
- model-quality regression score drop >= 3 points -> notify @danny + @erin

danny: Quick note: I'll publish a small eval set run before 10:00 and re-run at 10:15 and 11:05 to catch regressions early.

erin: Rollback plan: immediate rollback to v2.0 if any hard alerts. Manual rollback command (infra):
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/model-serving --to-revision=deployment.v2.0
```

oncall-sre: If we rollback, I'll coordinate a postmortem and freeze any further ramps until triage.

sasha: Two operational asks:
1) Keep the deploy window open +30m if we see transient flakiness so infra can remediate without forcing rollback.
2) Tag the rollout in the console and add the k/v cache warm flags: `--cache-warm=true` for first slice.

erin: Acks? Please react with :thumbsup: when you can own the item.

sasha: :thumbsup: (infra)

raj: :thumbsup: (metrics)

danny: :thumbsup: (model quality)

oncall-sre: :thumbsup: (oncall)

erin: Thanks all. I'll post a short status update in this thread at each ramp step and ping ops if we need to stop.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Preflight checks scheduled 30 minutes before deploy: CI tests, canary-health-checks, smoke-runner.

erin: OK — final checklist: deploy owner=erin, infra=Sasha, metrics=raj, model=danny, oncall=oncall-sre. Meeting-free rollout; fallback plan in place. See you tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

raj: One more — I'll add a temporary dashboard with only the canary cohort filter so we can see cohort-only metrics in the first hour.

erin: Perfect. Closing for now, will reopen thread for live updates during rollout.
